candidates.statement: In case a person is nominated, the details of the local contact person for Pharmacovigilance in Romania should be sent to the NAMMDR, through an official address, in written or electronic format (email addresses:
candidates.context: To facilitate communication in the pharmacovigilance area , the MAH is reccommended t o nominat e such a local contact person . It is also recomm e nded that the contact person resides in Romania and is medically qualified or has access to a medically qualified person. It is necessary for the local contact person to be trained in P harmacovigilance by the MAH . Pharmacovigilance and Risk Management Unit. The Pharmacovigilance System Master File is managed by the EU QPPV who resides and operates in the European Union and who is responsible for the establishment and maintenance of the pharmacovigilance system .
